query: I'm reviewing acme/sdk#88, which someone else wrote. This session has no PR linked. Leave comments on `sdk/config.py` line 41 (a question about the hardcoded 30) and one general note that the PR has no tests. Don't stage a review, just leave normal comments.
expected_behavior: Does not stop at pasteable drafts or say comments can't be posted because no PR is linked
Does not call add_pr_review_comment and does not create a pending review
Posts the line 41 comment as a annotated line comment through gh api repos/acme/sdk/pulls/88/comments with -F body=@file, commit_id from the PR head SHA, and side RIGHT
Posts the no-tests note as a PR-level comment through gh pr comment --body-file
Both comments carry a plain-text conventional label and end with <!--:robot:--> as the last line
Re-fetches each posted comment body to verify what landed
